sections.title: Delivered
sections.text:
- **Gate `provider-size`** (S1–S3). `max_bindings` 20 → 8, no `note`, `forbid_anonymous_classes`, `single_return_factories`, `registrar_globs` (`*/src/**/*Registrar.php`); the ratchet only fell: every divided provider is now `0`, the rest keep their measured numbers. Before: S1 ×3 (core 26, intl 15, notifications 13), S2 ×2, S3 ×14 in providers plus 17 in registrars; after: none. Negative controls in `ProviderSizeTest`: nine bindings (`total=9 max_bindings=8`), `new class` (S2), multi-statement closure in a provider and in a registrar (S3), plus the single-return acceptance case and the "bindings outside a provider are not counted" case.
- **`SingletonInjectionGate`** scans `*Registrar.php` too; no new L1 finding on the clean tree, allowlist unchanged (two entries, P05.3 empties it); negative control with a probe registrar.
- **Division.** Table below. All bindings kept their order and lifetime; the only lifetime-sensitive reorder is `ModulesServiceProvider`, see deviations.
- **Named classes**: `DefaultReplayAuthorizer`, `ConfiguredCursorKeyring`, `HandlerFailure`; `git grep -E 'new (readonly )?class' -- 'packages/*/src/*' ':!packages/*/src/**/PHPStan/**'` → exit 1.
- **Static registrars**: no `…Registrar::register|boot(` call remains in `packages/*/src` (exit 1); instance registrars implement `PackageRegistrar`.
- **Factories** (`Laravel/<Thing>Factory`): `WorkflowBindingFactory`, `MeilisearchProviderFactory`, `SavedViewRepositoryFactory`, `GdThumbnailDriverFactory`, `IdempotencyStoreFactory`, `ProblemRegistryFactory`, and in custom-fields `AttributeStoreFactory`, `SchemaOperationsFactory`, `FieldCatalogueFactory`. Existing registrars with several-statement closures got named private methods (tenancy, webhooks, bulk, modules, custom-fields composition) or a real command class (`RepairModuleCommand` replaces `Artisan::command(…)`).
- **Core**: one public provider; `packages/core/composer.json` `extra.laravel.providers` is exactly `CoreX\CoreServiceProvider`; `manifest-check` exit 0.

| Provider | Registrars |
|:--|:--|
| core `CoreServiceProvider` | Errors, Observability, Config, Context, Data, Messaging, Settings, Audit, Features, Departments, Storage, Time, CoreModules (+ registers `ModulesServiceProvider`) |
| access | AccessBindings, AccessIntegration |
| custom-fields | AttributeMessaging, AttributeComposition, AttributeBindings (+ 3 factories) |
| intl | IntlBindings, IntlReference |
| media | MediaBindings (+ GdThumbnailDriverFactory) |
| notifications | NotificationsBindings, NotificationsDigest |
| operations | OperationsBindings, Idempotency, Pagination, Http, ApiSchemaBindings, CostBindings, BulkBindings (+ BulkHttpRegistrar) |
| panels | SavedViewsBindings, PanelsBindings |
| wakeup | WakeupBindings |
| webhooks | WebhookBindings (+ WebhookHttpRegistrar) |
| workflow, search-meilisearch, tasks | factory / named method only (S3) |

sections.title: Deviations from the dossier
sections.text:
- **Backward compatibility wins over "static → instance".** `bc-check` rejected the static→instance change of public Spi types (`Method register() … changed scope from static to instance`) in stable packages. The instance registrars therefore have new names (`SavedViewsBindingsRegistrar`, `CostBindingsRegistrar`, `BulkBindingsRegistrar`, `WebhookBindingsRegistrar`, `ApiSchemaBindingsRegistrar`); the old classes (`SavedViewsRegistrar`, `CostRegistrar`, `BulkRegistrar`, `WebhookRegistrar`, `ApiSchemaRegistrar`, `BulkRouteRegistrar`, `WebhookRouteRegistrar`) keep their static entry points as deprecated shims delegating to the new ones. Their `register()` is no longer called from the providers.
- **Registrars and factories are `#[Spi(kind: Call)]`**, not internal: the package-graph gate (R4b) classifies every public top-level type, and the existing tenancy registrars follow the same precedent. 40 types joined the manifests (Golden delta below).
- **`ModulesServiceProvider` is registered at the end of `CoreServiceProvider::register()`**, not first: module services (`CompiledSettingDefaultsProvider`, registries) refine kernel bindings, and a binding registered later wins. Registering first made the kernel overwrite them (reproduced by `CompositionBindingsTest`). Consequence: applications and package test apps that boot the kernel now have the module registry too; `AttributesServiceProviderTest` expects `QueuedSchemaOperations` and was renamed accordingly, `ExtensionRemediationTest` force-re-registers the module provider under the production environment.
- Core registrars `Data/Laravel/DataRegistrar` and `Time/Laravel/TimeRegistrar` sit in directories the litmus test treats as Foundation; they are listed in `LITMUS_FOUNDATION` and in the `CoreZoneTest` composition list.
- The `ModulesOptions` singleton moved into `RegistryRegistrar::register` (a provider binding would have grown the provider ratchet).
- The Meilisearch and Idempotency factories keep config reads (`app.key`) in `*Factory.php`, an allowed composition path of `config-composition-gate`.
- Tests that rewrite module config after boot got `forgetInstance(ModulesOptions::class)` (core Modules and root lifecycle/registry tests); `ApiContractTest` now reads the replay authorizer source from `DefaultReplayAuthorizer.php`.
- PHPStan: obsolete baseline entries of the moved code were pruned (counts only decreased), no new ignores.

sections.title: Golden delta
sections.text: `golden-semantic-delta.json`: removed `CoreX\Errors\Internal\ProblemRegistryRegistrar`; 48 added records (registrars, factories, named classes, `ConfiguredImplementation`, `RepairModuleCommand`, shims' new targets); 4 changed (`ApiSchemaRegistrar` + `fromSchema`/deprecation, `SavedViewsRegistrar` deprecation, two custom-fields registrars implementing `PackageRegistrar`). Routes, events and wire are byte-identical; no `GOLDEN_UPDATE` in the final run. `REBASELINE.md` row added.
